words.d: the part of a plant that grows under the ground
the rough outer skin of a tree trunk
a desert plant covered in sharp spines
a soft green plant that carpets rocks and trees
a flower on a tree, like cherry blossom
a bunch of flowers arranged together
a chain of flowers worn or hung as decoration
covered by plants growing out of control
the dark earth that plants grow in
a container with a spout for watering plants
a stem growing out from a plant's main stem
to put seeds or young plants into the ground
a field of short cut grass
to move something quickly back and forth
a plant that crowds out garden plants
there in very large amounts
cheap enough for you to pay for
to say you are sorry for something
a plant that lives for only one year
to break open and turn over the soil
to press something firmly into place
to use something for a job

videos.desc: An anime girl in overalls kneels in a garden and lifts a seedling out of the soil, revealing its long pale roots. She shakes off the dirt, rinses the roots in a bowl of water, replants the seedling and waters it.

In a northern forest a young man and woman touch and knock on the thick cracked bark of a pine while a woodpecker clings to the trunk; they then walk to a birch and peel off a small curl of its papery white bark to show the camera.

A couple wanders through a desert garden full of tall saguaro and round barrel cacti; the camera zooms onto the long sharp spines and the woman points at them, joking that they are far too sharp to touch.

In a misty forest full of green-covered boulders, two people press their hands into the thick springy moss on a rock, leaving hand prints that slowly spring back. One squeezes a wet clump of moss so water drips out, then a woman rests her cheek on the soft mossy rock like a pillow.

Two gardeners scoop up handfuls of dark crumbly soil from a raised bed, let it fall between their fingers and find a little earthworm in it, then plant spring-onion seedlings into the soil, pat it flat and water the row.

A young man in a red tracksuit jacket stands under an apple tree in a garden at night, with a black dog beside him and yellow apples already scattered over the grass. He grabs a low branch and shakes it hard, and more apples drop around him. The dog trots through the fallen fruit and he climbs up onto the concrete fence.

A sunny back garden with a mown grass lawn and a tall green hedge along the back. Two fluffy dogs stand on the grass: a small cream Pomeranian and a bigger black and tan Lapphund. Between them on the lawn sits a round blue pet drinking fountain that shoots a thin jet of water straight up into the air. The dogs watch the jet, then the black and tan dog steps up to the fountain and drinks from it while the cream one circles around, jumps up and paws at the water, and the two take turns at the bowl on the grass.

A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup. In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.

A woman in a coat and a checked scarf arrives at an open front door holding a wine bottle and a paper-wrapped bouquet, hands the bouquet to the man who greets her, joins a table lit by fairy lights where food is served out of a red pan, and clinks a glass of white wine with the others.

Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.

A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.

A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.

In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.

At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.

On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.

A young man in a straw hat and a football shirt kneels in a vegetable bed between rows of leafy green plants, a tall corn field behind him. He digs his gloved hands into the dark soil around the base of a big unwanted plant, works it loose, grips it low down and pulls hard. He rocks back, drags the plant out of the ground and stands up holding it above the bed, its long soil-covered roots and leafy top hanging down.

An apple orchard in warm evening sunlight. The trees are so full of red and green apples that the branches bend down. A young woman with twisted hair tied up, in an olive utility shirt and trousers, carries an overflowing basket on her hip, reaches up into the branches and picks another apple, laughing, while apples drop to the ground. Along the row stand wooden bushel baskets heaped with apples, more apples lie all over the grass, and two men work by a trailer stacked with crates.

An outdoor flower market under a grey-and-white striped awning on a sunny day. A young woman with long wavy blonde hair, in a pink knitted jumper and a white skirt, takes a huge bunch of pink and white peonies from a smiling young stallholder in a white shirt and brown leather apron, hugs it and smells the flowers happily while he gestures and laughs. In front of them wooden tubs and crates overflow with peonies and tulips in brown paper cones, and a bicycle with a basket leans on the stall.

In a cottage garden at sunset, with a honey-coloured stone house, tall hollyhocks and a pale blue wooden gate, a young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and muddy navy trousers keeps a hand on his chest and smiles sheepishly. Beside him a brown-and-white spaniel sits by a dug-up flower bed with pansies ripped out and soil everywhere, then jumps up and sits again. A young woman in a green T-shirt and denim shorts stands with her arms crossed, then smiles and points a trowel at the mess.

On a desert plain covered in bright orange wild poppies under dark stormy clouds, a dry seed pod on a tall stalk in the foreground bursts open and sprays a cloud of tiny black seeds into the air. Petals and dust blow in the wind and young green shoots grow from the red soil. A tortoise sits among the flowers, a herd of horses gallops past a spiky Joshua tree towards the front, and a hawk flies over snow-topped mountains.

In a vineyard in soft morning light, a young woman with a long dark braid, an olive T-shirt, dark jeans and brown boots guides a small metal plough pulled by a brown horse between rows of green grapevines. The blade cuts into the dark soil, turning up a deep furrow and throwing clumps of earth into the air in a cloud of dust. Seagulls land and fly behind her, a fox walks between the vines, and a stone farmhouse and tall cypress trees stand in the distance.

A wet peat bog on a grey day. A young woman in a red rain jacket, a knit hat and green wellies kneels in the black mud and presses a clump of green moss firmly into the waterlogged ground, then lifts her hands, wipes her arm and reaches for the next spot. Long rows of moss clumps already planted stretch away beside her. Behind her other volunteers in rain jackets plant more or carry sacks, rolls of brown matting are stacked by a wooden boardwalk, a small hut stands on the horizon and a bird flies overhead.

At a farm gate by a vineyard on a sunny day, a smiling young woman in a straw hat, denim shirt and work trousers leans on an open wooden gate while a flock of sheep walks past her through the gate in a small cloud of dust. She laughs, stands up and pats one of the sheep. A small ride-on mower stands unused under a black cover behind her at the end of the vines. A brown and white dog lies calmly on the grass in front, and dry golden hills rise under the clear sky.

In a back garden in low golden evening light, a young woman with her hair in a bun, in a white top and denim shorts, crouches barefoot in a freshly dug pond hole covered with a big sheet of shiny black plastic lining. Water from a green hose spreads over the bottom while she smooths the lining with her hands, then moves forward on her knees towards the edge, where bricks lie on the lining. Four friends crouch around the rim watching, a dog peeks over the edge and a spade stands in the soil next to cut turf.

On a farm field at sunset, a big green tractor pulls a plough through the stubble, raising a cloud of dust and turning the soil into dark furrows. A young woman in a blue jacket sits in the cab. In front, a young man in a white T-shirt and orange trousers walks over the ploughed earth, looking at a handful of soil, and walks out of sight. A hawk on a wooden fence post spreads its wings and flies off over the field. Tall trees stand against an orange evening sky.

A young man in a white T-shirt, blue shorts and sandals waters a small vegetable garden with a hose on a sunny day, holding up a bunch of ripe red tomatoes from a plant. Behind the wooden garden fence, filling the whole background, a gigantic white cruise ship with a name on its hull glides past on the water, smoke rising from its funnel. The man looks up and speaks, then keeps watering. A deckchair, a metal watering can and pots of herbs stand on the brick path.

A small back garden in autumn in warm evening light. A bearded young man in a rust cardigan and jeans lies back in a hammock, reading a book and sipping from a mug, then looks up and smiles. Beside him a huge heap of raked brown and yellow leaves lies unfinished with a rake in it, and a wheelbarrow full of leaves stands by a green wooden shed. Leaves cover the lawn and keep falling from the tree above. String lights hang by the open glass door of the brick house.

A huge field of sunflowers on rolling hills at sunrise. Every flower head is turned the same way, towards the camera, while the sun glows low on the horizon on the right behind them. A small goldfinch flutters in front of one big sunflower, then flies off over the field towards the sun. Far behind, a lone tree, a row of tall cypress trees and a dirt road lie on the hills under a pale orange sky with a few pink clouds. Large green leaves fill the foreground.

A bright, warm glass greenhouse full of sunlight. A young woman with a long braid, a white blouse, green trousers and yellow rubber boots leaps over a huge orange pumpkin on the wet brick path, lands in a puddle and walks on laughing past a tall tomato plant full of red tomatoes and a sunflower, where a small bird lands. Behind her a young man in denim dungarees stands among the plants. Tall sunflowers, big leaves and climbing plants fill the space, and a coiled green hose and clay pots sit along the sides.

An old wooden greenhouse. An enormous pumpkin has grown so big that it has pushed out a glass pane and hangs against the broken window. A young woman with long dreadlocks, a green headscarf and work dungarees stands on a stepladder and wraps a measuring tape around it. A loose glass pane falls and breaks on the floor near the door. Thick green vines spread across the soil, a knocked-over watering can lies on the ground, and two young people stare in amazement through the glass door.

A tulip field in the country in soft morning light. Rows and rows of white tulips fill the view, and in the middle one single bright red tulip stands taller than all the others, swaying gently in the wind with the white flowers around it. Beside the field runs a narrow canal with a small bridge and a bicycle against a railing, and in the distance the sails of a windmill turn slowly next to farmhouses and a line of tall poplar trees.

A picnic in a formal park garden with clipped hedges and a green bench. A jet of water from a hidden lawn sprinkler shoots straight up through a red checked picnic blanket. A young woman in a white shirt and blue skirt jumps back in surprise, and a young man in a rust shirt holding a baguette falls back and rolls over, while a black spaniel leaps beside them. Then both crouch by the blanket and laugh as the water keeps spraying up. Straw hats and strawberries lie on the ground.
